_comment: SAMPLE DATA — one entry per market. `lead` is a person id or null (unassigned). Codex maintains readiness dates, NPS, scoreboard, competitor summaries/plays, launches and commercial figures from sourced signals; stakeholders, key dates, advisory board and key accountants are human-maintained (flag suspected changes via needsHuman). `advisoryBoard` carries dated insight from the market advisory board; `keyAccountants` are the practices we go to for insight and feedback; `commercial` holds targets, existing base size and ARR. Stakeholders carry `influence` (high|medium) and `relationship` (strong|developing|gap) forming the stakeholder map. `dependencies` lists what this market is waiting on from other teams: {name, on, status: on-track|at-risk|blocked, note, due}.
